Compound E, semagacestat, and dexamethasone are the best-supported retrieved donors by anchor similarity, but their pharmacology does not establish a shared histone mechanism with calpain inhibitor II.
Any donor-derived target-minus-A375 transfer remains a response-pattern prediction requiring measured donor values and cannot support viability or causal claims.
